fluff.overview: Com Guard conventional infantry benefit from ComStar's access to preserved Star League technology, fielding weapons and equipment that match or exceed the standard issue of any Inner Sphere military, backed by the institutional discipline of the secular Order's professional military culture. Motorized Level I formations use light vehicles to achieve rapid redeployment between positions, trading the armor protection of mechanized transports for greater speed and lower logistical burden. These formations excel at screening operations and can cover more ground than foot infantry during extended patrol assignments. Equipped with infantry-portable short-range missile launchers that provide anti-armor capability beyond what personal weapons can achieve, these troops can threaten light vehicles and battle armor at close range.
